tooltip.arcanum.set: Full set: +50 max mana, 2x regeneration, Speed
guide.arcanum.title: Arcanum Grimoire
guide.arcanum.no_craft: Cannot be crafted. Find it in the world and mine it.
guide.arcanum.mana_crystal_ore: Glowing ore found underground. Needs an iron pickaxe. Fortune works.
guide.arcanum.deepslate_mana_crystal_ore: The deepslate variant of the ore. Common deep below.
guide.arcanum.mana_crystal_block: Nine crystals in one block. Beautiful and a key part of the Mana Font.
guide.arcanum.arcane_bricks: Glowing runed bricks for towers, and for building the Mana Font.
guide.arcanum.arcane_lantern: A magical light source with the maximum brightness.
guide.arcanum.mana_font: Right-click with a Mana Crystal to instantly restore mana.
guide.arcanum.mana_crystal: Raw magical energy. Mine it from the ore. Used in almost every recipe.
guide.arcanum.arcane_ingot: Iron infused with mana. The base for armor and the strongest staffs.
guide.arcanum.arcane_tome: This very book. Right-click it anywhere to open the guide.
guide.arcanum.fire_wand: Launches an explosive fireball in the direction you look.
guide.arcanum.storm_staff: Strikes four lightning bolts at the target and shocks everything nearby.
guide.arcanum.frost_staff: Freezes and slows every enemy within 7 blocks around you.
guide.arcanum.life_staff: Heals you and nearby players, grants regeneration and absorption.
guide.arcanum.blink_staff: Teleports you up to 24 blocks forward, right where you look.
guide.arcanum.ruin_scepter: Ultimate weapon: blasts everything within 10 blocks, ignites it and calls lightning.
guide.arcanum.arcane_apple: Restores hunger, grants regeneration and absorption, plus mana.
guide.arcanum.starlight_cookie: A quick snack that grants Speed and restores a little mana.
guide.arcanum.lunar_pie: A hearty pie with Resistance, regeneration and a lot of mana.
guide.arcanum.arcane_helmet: +25 max mana, faster regeneration. Full set: +50 mana, 2x regen, Speed.
guide.arcanum.arcane_chestplate: +25 max mana, faster regeneration. Full set: +50 mana, 2x regen, Speed.
guide.arcanum.arcane_leggings: +25 max mana, faster regeneration. Full set: +50 mana, 2x regen, Speed.
guide.arcanum.arcane_boots: +25 max mana, faster regeneration. Full set: +50 mana, 2x regen, Speed.
